svg.aria-label: At a glance. I build production systems in Rust: multi-agent engineering platforms, financial reconciliation that is exact to the cent, and GPU compute on hardware I own. 9,000+ AI agent sessions; 6,100+ orchestrated subagents; 152B+ tokens processed; 467+ Rust crates, one workspace. Open to engineering roles and platform engagements · architecture reviews on request.
